note: The Recovery sizing panel now has a section for every stage that comes down separately - the sustainer, then each booster - each with its own weight, main and drogue, sized against that stage's own parachutes and airframe. A single-stage rocket sees exactly the panel it saw before; the sections appear only when more than one stage separates. Also: when an imported file's own value disagrees with the catalogue row it matched, the import note now says which part and which field, and that the file's value was kept. And a launch now sets every motor from your design before it flies, so it can never inherit a stale ejection delay from an earlier re-fly - a class of bug that shipped twice and was repaired in v0.105, now made impossible.
